== English Reflections III comparison ==
The original physically shows the Episode I icon. Decipher's January 2002 Glossary Supplement strikes that icon and says the card is outside the Episode I-only tournament environment. The Reflections III icon remains. The later D-E1 card and slip show the icon correction with unaltered battle and weapon text.
